name: Admin UI Only
description: Blocks front-end HTML access to non-admin pages (lockdown for API-only/decoupled backends).
project_description:
Limits a Drupal site to only providing an administration UI via HTML.

 Install this module to prevent users from accessing content via HTML but allow access via other request methods. This is useful if you want to allow anonymous access to a JSON:API or GraphQL endpoint but do not want to allow users to access content via Drupal.

 Installation 
 
 If the node module is installed, node configuration will be updated to ensure you can edit content in the admin UI. 
 The frontpage is always accessible via HTML. The best user experience can be achieved by setting the frontpage to 'user/login' 
 Set your administration theme to be your site's only theme to simplify configuration management.
